settings.title: International Shipping
settings.content: BLÓMINOR ships internationally. All orders include tracking. Free shipping on orders over NOK 4,000. For orders below NOK 4,000, shipping cost is shown at checkout.

settings.title: Taxes & Duties
settings.content: International orders may have local taxes or import fees. These are shown at checkout when possible, or may be collected on delivery depending on your country's customs regulations.

settings.title: Free Returns
settings.content: We offer free returns within 14 days of receiving your order. To start a return, complete the return form on our website. We will email prepaid return instructions and a return label.

settings.title: Return Conditions
settings.content: Jewellery must be unworn, undamaged and returned in its original packaging. All tags, protective materials and items included with the order must be returned. Once received and checked, we refund to the original payment method.
